dedupe_keys.name: akos slovenia geoportal network infrastructure coverage and planned works eanalitik market data and radio registers

description: The Slovenian communications regulator runs three public data services. Geoportal AKOS is its central portal for spatial data: electronic communications infrastructure, network access points, fixed and mobile network coverage, and intentions for planned public infrastructure works, which the agency collects from investors to encourage shared use and joint building. Users can check networks and services at any location, make PDF maps and run quick analyses that export access point data by municipality or settlement. eAnalitik presents the electronic communications market, covering fixed and mobile telephony, broadband, television, bundles and wholesale broadband, over the last ten years, from the quarterly reports of active operators, with charts and tables that can be exported. The agency's registers list radio frequency decisions, broadcast radio and television frequencies and transmitter sites, operators and numbering; the frequency decision holders are also on the national open data portal. Coverage: Slovenia, by location, settlement and municipality, and national quarterly series. Format and access: web map, exports and register pages, free. Caveats: the geoportal was down for upgrades in September 2026 and answered with an error; no licence statement was found; coverage is operator-reported. Simulation uses: network location and coverage layers, planned works and market series for Slovenian telecom models. Related records: AKOS Test Net open data gives measured speeds; the Digital Decade DESI indicators give EU coverage values.
